title: Germany Built AI You Can Actually Trust #SovereignAI #GDPR #OpenSource
description:
SOOFI S is a sovereign, open-source AI foundation model built in Germany that publishes its full training-data recipe — about 99% of its 27-trillion-token data mix can be rebuilt independently. A transparent open-weights LLM, not a chatbot: here's what "open" should actually mean.

What you will see in this ~100-second breakdown:
- Transparency is the real story — SOOFI publishes a per-source data breakdown, ~99% independently reconstructable (bias + licensing you can actually audit)
- 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts — 31.6B params total, only ~3.2B active per token, reaching dense-14B quality roughly 9× faster
- Trained 100% in Germany on European compute (Deutsche Telekom, Munich) across 512 NVIDIA B200 GPUs — easier to defend for GDPR, no US or Chinese vendor lock-in
- The honest part the team says out loud: this is NOT a frontier chatbot. Factual knowledge is limited by design. Sovereign does not mean superior
- Who it's for — you don't run this on a laptop. It's an open base model on Hugging Face to fine-tune on your own data and fully audit, not to chat with
- Roadmap: SOOFI S is the first rung — the goal is a ~100-billion-parameter family

SOOFI S base weights (Hugging Face): https://huggingface.co/Soofi-Project/Soofi-S-Base
Technical report (arXiv): https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09424
